Notebook Revision History: A Databricks feature to view and revert to
previous notebook versions.
Job Clusters: Clusters that are started and terminated with job execution,
used to reduce costs.
Interactive Cluster: A persistent cluster that remains active for user
interactions.
Auto-scaling: A feature in Databricks clusters that adjusts cluster size based
on workload,
Spark SQL: The SQ1 interface for Spark, enabling querying of structured data,
Structured Streaming: Spark's stream processing framework, allowing
processing of live data.
Databrieks CLI: Command-line tool for managing Databricks resources.
Metastore: The repository for storing table metadata in Databricks.
Partitioning: Dividing data into parts to increase query speed in big data
processing
Data skipping: An optimization technique that skips irrelevant data blocks.
Run: Execution of a job or notebook in Databricks.
